reference_sql:
SELECT p.category_id,
       s.category_name,
       w.iso_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) AS products_matched,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) / SUM(s.units * w.avg_competitor_price_eur), 1) AS price_index,
       CASE
         WHEN ROUND(100 * SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) / SUM(s.units * w.avg_competitor_price_eur), 1) > 102 THEN 'premium'
         WHEN ROUND(100 * SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) / SUM(s.units * w.avg_competitor_price_eur), 1) < 98 THEN 'discount'
         ELSE 'parity'
       END AS position
FROM sales AS s
JOIN calendar AS c ON c.cal_date = s.order_date
JOIN competitor_price_weekly AS w
  ON w.product_id = s.product_id
 AND w.iso_year = c.iso_year
 AND w.iso_week = c.iso_week
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-24' AND DATE '2025-03-16'
GROUP BY p.category_id, s.category_name, w.iso_week
ORDER BY w.iso_week, price_index DESC, p.category_id

solver.query:
SELECT c.category_id,
       c.category_name,
       weekofyear(s.order_date) AS iso_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) AS products_matched,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) / SUM(s.units * w.avg_competitor_price_eur), 1) AS price_index,
       CASE WHEN ROUND(100 * SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) / SUM(s.units * w.avg_competitor_price_eur), 1) > 102.0 THEN 'premium'
            WHEN ROUND(100 * SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) / SUM(s.units * w.avg_competitor_price_eur), 1) < 98.0 THEN 'discount'
            ELSE 'parity' END AS position
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN competitor_price_weekly w ON w.product_id = s.product_id
     AND w.iso_year = 2025 AND w.iso_week = weekofyear(s.order_date)
WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-24' AND DATE '2025-03-16'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, weekofyear(s.order_date)
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) >= 1
ORDER BY iso_week, price_index DESC, c.category_id
